input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment ... for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
input.rationale: We hold a convenience right on one month's notice (better than our preferred 30 days), IBM must keep performing through the termination date, and IBM has no convenience right at all — only termination for uncured material breach under § 3.3. Noted, not flagged here: the early termination charges referenced in Attachment A are not quantified or capped; we address that cap under the LD rule to avoid duplicating the same commercial ask.

input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
input.rationale: The 90-day non-renewal window exceeds our fallback of 60 days, and renewal for a term "equal in duration to the previous term" produces automatic multi-year renewals where an Order Form term is multi-year — walk-away territory. Redline fixes renewals at 12 months and shortens the notice window to 30 days; uncapped renewal pricing is mitigated by the § 13.1 fee-free exit on price change, so we note rather than redline uplift.

input.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
input.rationale: New York law is our preferred governing law and there is no arbitration clause or foreign venue. Noted, not flagged: no express exclusive venue in New York County (we would add it if the draft reopens), and § 14.14 imposes a two-year contractual limitations period, which is a separate point outside this rule.

input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: This sits at the fallback: we may assign to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition without consent, other assignments need consent that cannot be unreasonably withheld, and there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right for IBM. Noted, not flagged: no express affiliate carve-out for us and no restriction on IBM's own assignment (IBM may also subcontract under § 14.8) — asks we would raise if the draft reopens.
